description: Official P0 semantic metric identities for claim_semantics_v2 evaluation-only slice. F-02 adds required-vs-final oracle identities; v1 identities remain historically registered.

metrics.formula: count(material gold atoms receiving one-to-one match credit from an eligible extracted candidate) / count(material gold atoms)
metrics.numerator_definition: Distinct material gold atom IDs matched one-to-one to an eligible canonical extracted candidate via frozen allowed_matches after deterministic maximum-cardinality matching.
metrics.denominator_definition: Count of material gold atom rows in the frozen gold inventory for the evaluated asset.
metrics.eligibility_population: Evaluated assets with valid frozen gold, span, draft identity, materiality, and allowed match edges.
metrics.aggregation: none; mandatory per evaluated asset/fixture in this slice
metrics.missing_invalid_behavior: INVALID when required gold, span, draft SHA-256, materiality, or match-edge identity is missing, inconsistent, or tampered; evaluation fails closed.
metrics.zero_denominator_behavior: N/A / undefined with explicit undefined_reason when zero material gold atoms; never silently 0 or 1.
metrics.range_unit: [0,1] ratio; raw integer numerator and denominator always persisted
metrics.exact_meaning: Extraction coverage of the independent material-claim inventory.
metrics.explicit_non_meaning: Does not measure evidence correctness, verifier correctness, semantic resolution, or factual accuracy.
metrics.provenance_requirements: Human-adjudicated frozen fixture with draft_sha256, spans, material flags, allowed_matches, and candidate roles; no model-generated canonical IDs as independent truth.
metrics.reference_implementation_requirements: scripts/evaluate_claim_semantics_v2.py; MATCH_INELIGIBLE_ROLES={compound,fragment,qualifier_loss,invention}; forbidden-role allowed edges fail closed; deterministic ID-sorted matching.
metrics.migration_versioning_rules: v2 breaks v1 recall eligibility by adding qualifier_loss and invention to match-ineligible roles; v1 material_claim_recall remains historical and immutable.

metrics.formula: count(material gold atoms without validly verified final binding) / count(material gold atoms)
metrics.numerator_definition: Material gold atoms where any unresolved condition holds: omitted extraction, only weak final disposition, unverified gold label, forbidden-role-only representation, invalid evidence binding, binding not fully entailing the claim, or oracle-proven false verification.
metrics.denominator_definition: Count of material gold atom rows in the frozen gold inventory.
metrics.eligibility_population: Evaluated assets with valid frozen claim, evidence-binding, and identity provenance.
metrics.aggregation: none; mandatory per evaluated asset/fixture in this slice
metrics.missing_invalid_behavior: INVALID when required claim/evidence/binding identity is missing or inconsistent; evaluation fails closed.
metrics.zero_denominator_behavior: N/A / undefined when zero material gold atoms.
metrics.range_unit: [0,1] ratio; raw integer numerator and denominator always persisted
metrics.exact_meaning: Fraction of independently identified material claims the system failed to defensibly resolve.
metrics.explicit_non_meaning: Does not measure emitted-row unverified rate, historical UVR, or factual error prevalence.
metrics.authority: P0 semantic qualification pack; required target 0 unresolved material atoms for automatic semantic PASS
metrics.provenance_requirements: Frozen gold_semantic_status, predicted_semantic_status on matched candidates, and evidence_bindings with valid and fully_entailed flags.
metrics.reference_implementation_requirements: scripts/evaluate_claim_semantics_v2.py; unresolved is downstream disposition not a fourth verifier label; human publication exceptions never remove atoms from numerator.
metrics.migration_versioning_rules: New P0 semantic metric; orthogonal to historical UVR_v1.

metrics.formula: count(material gold weak-or-unverified cases predicted verified) / count(eligible material gold weak-or-unverified cases)
metrics.numerator_definition: Material gold atoms whose independent gold_semantic_status is weak or unverified and whose matched candidate predicted_semantic_status is verified.
metrics.denominator_definition: All material gold atoms with gold_semantic_status weak or unverified in the evaluated asset.
metrics.eligibility_population: Fixed independently labeled material claim/evidence cases with gold label weak or unverified.
metrics.aggregation: none; mandatory per evaluated asset/fixture in this slice
metrics.missing_invalid_behavior: INVALID when required gold or prediction identity is missing; evaluation fails closed.
metrics.zero_denominator_behavior: N/A / undefined when zero eligible weak-or-unverified material cases; qualification pack inadequate for this metric.
metrics.range_unit: [0,1] ratio; raw integer numerator and denominator always persisted
metrics.exact_meaning: Unsafe promotion of known unresolved material cases into verified.
metrics.explicit_non_meaning: Does not measure precision among all predicted verified claims, extraction recall, or overall factual accuracy.
metrics.authority: P0 semantic safety qualification; raw false-verification count must be zero
metrics.provenance_requirements: Frozen gold_semantic_status and candidate predicted_semantic_status linked by allowed_matches.
metrics.reference_implementation_requirements: scripts/evaluate_claim_semantics_v2.py; count only material gold with gold label weak or unverified.
metrics.migration_versioning_rules: Historical required-gold population only. v2 is a distinct identity covering independently frozen material weak/unverified final claims, including unmatched claims.

metrics.formula: count(independently frozen material weak-or-unverified classification cases predicted verified) / count(independently frozen material weak-or-unverified classification cases)
metrics.numerator_definition: Independently frozen FIXED CLASSIFICATION CASE catalog rows whose independent semantic label is weak or unverified and whose automated prediction is verified. The catalog may include required claim/evidence cases, final-content cases, and unmatched final cases. Selection does not depend on successful extraction, final_atoms membership, required-gold matching, or candidate survival.
metrics.denominator_definition: All independently frozen material classification cases with independent semantic label weak or unverified, including required cases omitted from final content when the fixture specifies them.
metrics.eligibility_population: F-02 assets with an independently frozen fixed-classification catalog.
metrics.aggregation: none; mandatory per evaluated asset/fixture in this slice
metrics.missing_invalid_behavior: INVALID when required final-claim, materiality, or prediction identity is missing; evaluation fails closed.
metrics.zero_denominator_behavior: N/A / undefined when zero independently frozen material weak-or-unverified final claims.
metrics.range_unit: [0,1] ratio; raw integer numerator and denominator always persisted
metrics.exact_meaning: Unsafe promotion of independently weak/unverified material classification cases into verified, including unmatched new claims and omitted required cases when specified in the catalog.
metrics.explicit_non_meaning: Does not replace v1; is not derived from final_atoms alone; does not use required-gold matching or extraction success to select classifier cases; does not treat unmatched as unverified automatically.
metrics.authority: P0 semantic safety qualification F-02; a weak/unverified material final claim predicted verified must count
metrics.provenance_requirements: Frozen independent_semantic_label, predicted_semantic_status, material boolean, and fixture identity digest; no model-generated materiality.
metrics.reference_implementation_requirements: scripts/evaluate_claim_semantics_v2.py; iterate fixture fixed_classification_cases only; a required case omitted from F remains in the denominator when the catalog specifies it.
metrics.migration_versioning_rules: Versions forward from material_false_verification_rate.v1; v1 remains historically registered and required-gold-only.

metrics.formula: count(oracle-failing assets with automatic route PASS) / count(eligible oracle-failing assets)
metrics.numerator_definition: Integrated assets whose semantic oracle requires FAIL (any unresolved material atom) but whose recorded automatic_route.decision is PASS.
metrics.denominator_definition: All eligible integrated assets whose independent semantic oracle says the asset must fail.
metrics.eligibility_population: Integrated assets with valid automatic route evidence and computable oracle disposition.
metrics.aggregation: pack-level in this slice; duplicated on per-fixture results for traceability
metrics.missing_invalid_behavior: INVALID when route or oracle evidence is missing; evaluation fails closed.
metrics.zero_denominator_behavior: N/A / undefined when zero oracle-failing assets; safety pack inadequate.
metrics.range_unit: [0,1] ratio; raw integer numerator and denominator always persisted
metrics.explicit_non_meaning: Does not measure prose quality, human utility, false rejection rate, or verifier-only classifier accuracy.
metrics.authority: P0 semantic safety qualification; numerator must be zero
metrics.provenance_requirements: Frozen automatic_route.decision and oracle semantic_pass derived from material_claim_unresolved_rate.v1.
metrics.reference_implementation_requirements: scripts/evaluate_claim_semantics_v2.py; oracle semantic_pass iff zero unresolved material atoms.
metrics.migration_versioning_rules: Historical G-only oracle. v2 is a distinct identity using the corrected required+final oracle. v1 remains historically registered.

metrics.formula: count(corrected-oracle FAIL assets recorded as automatic PASS) / count(corrected-oracle FAIL assets)
metrics.numerator_definition: Integrated assets whose corrected required+final semantic oracle requires FAIL (unresolved required material claims != 0 or unresolved final material claims != 0) but whose recorded automatic_route.decision is PASS.
metrics.denominator_definition: All eligible integrated assets whose corrected required+final semantic oracle says the asset must fail.
metrics.eligibility_population: F-02 assets with valid automatic route evidence, required gold inventory, and final factual inventory.
metrics.aggregation: pack-level in this slice; duplicated on per-fixture results for traceability; F-C evaluated as a unit yields 1/1
metrics.missing_invalid_behavior: INVALID when route or oracle evidence is missing; evaluation fails closed. INVALID and N/A are never coerced into PASS.
metrics.zero_denominator_behavior: N/A / undefined when zero corrected-oracle FAIL assets, or when a historical revisionless fixture has no final-claim inventory.
metrics.range_unit: [0,1] ratio; raw integer numerator and denominator always persisted
metrics.exact_meaning: Direct integrated false-green frequency under the corrected required+final oracle.
metrics.explicit_non_meaning: Does not reinterpret v1; does not measure prose quality, human utility, or publication approval.
metrics.authority: P0 semantic safety qualification F-02; numerator must be zero
metrics.provenance_requirements: Frozen automatic_route.decision and corrected oracle semantic_pass derived from required unresolved = 0 AND final unresolved = 0.
metrics.reference_implementation_requirements: scripts/evaluate_claim_semantics_v2.py; PASS iff unresolved required material count U_G = 0 AND unresolved final material count U_F = 0. Zero-denominator rates are N/A and are not coerced into FAIL or PASS.
metrics.migration_versioning_rules: Versions forward from automatic_semantic_false_pass_rate.v1; v1 remains historically registered and G-only.

metrics.formula: count(unresolved independently adjudicated final material claims) / count(all independently adjudicated final material claims)
metrics.numerator_definition: Independently adjudicated final material claims that fail the F-02 resolution rule: independent label verified, qualifying prediction exists and is verified, binding targets that final claim, binding is valid and fully entailing, and required identities are structurally valid.
metrics.denominator_definition: Count of independently adjudicated final material claims in the frozen final factual inventory. Being unmatched to required gold does not by itself place a claim in the numerator.
metrics.eligibility_population: F-02 assets with a frozen final factual inventory and independent material booleans.
metrics.aggregation: none; mandatory per evaluated asset/fixture in this slice
metrics.missing_invalid_behavior: INVALID when required final-claim identity, span, materiality, or binding structure is missing or inconsistent; evaluation fails closed.
metrics.zero_denominator_behavior: N/A / undefined with explicit undefined_reason when zero independently adjudicated final material claims; never silently 0 or 1; N/A is never coerced into PASS.
metrics.range_unit: [0,1] ratio; raw integer numerator and denominator always persisted
metrics.exact_meaning: Fraction of independently identified final material claims the system failed to defensibly resolve, including supported-new, weak-new, and unsupported-new claims.
metrics.explicit_non_meaning: Does not change required-gold recall or required unresolved rate; does not treat unmatched as automatically unsafe; automatic PASS requires raw unresolved numerator = 0.
metrics.authority: P0 semantic qualification F-02; automatic PASS requires unresolved final material numerator = 0
metrics.provenance_requirements: Frozen final_atoms with independent material boolean, independent_semantic_label, prediction identity/status, reference_relationship, and binding assessment; approved fixture/manifest digest.
metrics.reference_implementation_requirements: scripts/evaluate_claim_semantics_v2.py; gold weak+predicted weak unresolved; gold weak/unverified+predicted verified unresolved and false-verification; gold verified+invalid binding unresolved; supported-new verified with valid binding resolved.
metrics.migration_versioning_rules: New F-02 identity. Does not alter material_claim_unresolved_rate.v1, which remains required-gold-only.

metrics.formula: U / (V + W + U) where U, V, W are post-dedup emitted verifier row counts by status
metrics.numerator_definition: Count of post-dedup emitted verifier rows with status unverified.
metrics.denominator_definition: Sum of post-dedup emitted verifier rows with status verified, weak, or unverified.
metrics.eligibility_population: Assets with recorded post-dedup verifier_rows identity.
metrics.aggregation: none; historical sidecar coexisting with new semantic metrics
metrics.missing_invalid_behavior: INVALID when verifier row identity or status is missing or inconsistent.
metrics.zero_denominator_behavior: N/A / undefined when zero post-dedup emitted verifier rows.
metrics.range_unit: [0,1] ratio; raw integer numerator and denominator always persisted
metrics.explicit_non_meaning: Does not measure material claim unresolved rate, claim completeness, evidence defensibility, or semantic recall. Ten weak rows and no verified/unverified rows yield 0/10=0 by historical design.
metrics.provenance_requirements: Frozen verifier_rows with status in {verified, weak, unverified}; do not recompute historical artifacts under new semantics.
metrics.reference_implementation_requirements: scripts/evaluate_claim_semantics_v2.py compute_uvr_v1(); must coexist with semantic failure without ambiguity.
metrics.migration_versioning_rules: Immutable historical registration; not the new semantic oracle; never modified retroactively.
